executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under severe pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest areas. New capacity and improved yields can relieve the market, but will do so with a time lag. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
